system.description:
You raise your weapon above your head, swinging it in mighty arcs until the weapon becomes a blur of destructive force.

You may move up to your movement speed and unleash a 30-foot cone of destructive force up to 3 times throughout that movement, originating from a point of a space you are moving through for each cone.

All creatures in each affected area must make a Strength Saving Throw, being throw straight back 20 feet and taking you [Weapons damage] +2d12 and gaining 2 ranks of Concussed or only half as much damage, on a success. A creature can be affected by this Jutsu no more than twice.

Chain 3: You treat Jutsu based structures and constructs as if they are vulnerable to this jutsu’s damage. Additionally, if this jutsu deals damage to a Staggered creature, you extend the duration of the Staggered until the end of your next turn.
